research_role: one full article-level event extraction after Stage 1 pass; no outcome join or trading action
selection_basis: V3.4 passed every predeclared Stage 1 reliability requirement after a deterministic, source-preserving ellipsis alignment correction. The previously failing v3.3 raw response was also parsed into an exact frozen-headline substring without another model call. This config opens only one full extraction over the frozen 39,393-headline input. No market outcome, predictive metric, threshold, or trading result was consulted.

completion_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before the extraction artifact can be frozen for downstream design

prohibited: joining market outcomes during full extraction
computing predictive metrics, selecting a target or horizon, or tuning a threshold
creating an action, position size, backtest, or Tech overlay
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
